This is a multi-story feature.

integration.notes: User selected both supplied context and live inspection. Required authoring-time learning coordinates the model proposal gateway, backend session/revision ledger, trusted runner/browser, CSI/authentication/secret policy and evidence persistence, with cross-component state/advance identity and ambiguous-outcome handling.

infrastructure.notes: Forward-only context/revision/evidence and learning-session ledger schema changes are needed. Bounded isolated browser sessions reuse the planned Epic 10 runner infrastructure with independent authoring capacity/cleanup controls; it is not assumed deployed.

knowledge.notes: React/Java/Playwright/gateway technologies already exist; deterministic scoped-context resolution, evidence provenance and semantic/literal correspondence are new patterns. Official Playwright API/runtime compatibility research is required, without assuming a new library.

risk.notes: Wrong targets, changed exact text, stale contexts or preview/execution mismatch can produce incorrect state-changing browser actions. Context and page content also expand injection, secret and CSI isolation boundaries. Validation, exact confirmation and controlled fixture evaluation are required.
